heroHeadline: Paz hikes diesel price for big buyers as Morales alleges assassination plot
heroSubtitle: Decree 5676 lifts diesel to Bs. 18/L for large industrial consumers while the subsidized Bs. 9.80 rate holds for transport and households; Defense Minister Justiniano rejects Evo Morales's unproven claim of a U.S.-backed plot on his life from Chapare.
